prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Prakash V., Ashok bhai, Mahesh bhai, Prakash bhai.
The chat covers 16/04/26, 6:00 pm to 16/04/26, 8:00 pm. It must have exactly 26 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
16/04/26, 6:58 pm - Prakash bhai: Mahesh bhai, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
text:
16/04/26, 6:00 pm - Prakash V.: Haan bhai sab log active ho kya group pe?
16/04/26, 6:05 pm - Ashok bhai: Haan Prakash, main online hoon. Kya hua?
16/04/26, 6:10 pm - Mahesh bhai: Main bhi hoon, bolo kya updates hain.
16/04/26, 6:15 pm - Prakash bhai: Aaj ka kaam kaisa raha sabka?
16/04/26, 6:20 pm - Prakash V.: Dukan ka daily entry ho gaya hai mera.
16/04/26, 6:24 pm - Ashok bhai: Haan mera bhi daily accounts tally ho gaya.
16/04/26, 6:28 pm - Mahesh bhai: Kal ki meeting ka timing fix hua kya?
16/04/26, 6:32 pm - Prakash V.: Kal shaam 5 baje milte hain shop pe.
16/04/26, 6:36 pm - Ashok bhai: Theek hai, 5 baje done.
16/04/26, 6:40 pm - Prakash bhai: Suno, wo payment ka slip bhej do group pe.
16/04/26, 6:45 pm - Mahesh bhai: Kaunsa slip? Vendor wala?
16/04/26, 6:48 pm - Prakash V.: Haan jo dopahar ko aaya tha.
16/04/26, 6:52 pm - Ashok bhai: Wo toh Mahesh ne process kiya tha na.
16/04/26, 6:55 pm - Mahesh bhai: Haan maine screenshot save kiya tha.
16/04/26, 6:58 pm - Prakash bhai: Mahesh bhai, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
16/04/26, 7:02 pm - Mahesh bhai: Achha thik hai, main abhi kar deta hoon.
16/04/26, 7:08 pm - Prakash V.: Baaki ka ledger kal check karenge.
16/04/26, 7:15 pm - Ashok bhai: Okay, main kal subah bank ja raha hoon waise bhi.
16/04/26, 7:22 pm - Prakash bhai: Theek hai Ashok, passbook update karva lena.
16/04/26, 7:30 pm - Mahesh bhai: Record clear ho gaya hai screen se.
16/04/26, 7:36 pm - Prakash V.: Sahi hai, koi issue nahi aayega ab.
16/04/26, 7:42 pm - Ashok bhai: Kal subah milte hain sab dukan pe.
16/04/26, 7:48 pm - Prakash bhai: Haan sab time pe aa jana.
16/04/26, 7:52 pm - Mahesh bhai: Chalo good night sabko.
16/04/26, 7:56 pm - Prakash V.: Good night bhai.
16/04/26, 8:00 pm - Ashok bhai: Good night.
